### Prayers of Thanksgiving
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/prayers-of-thanksgiving
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 1:2-3
Points:
- Paul regularly and habitually lifted up prayers of gratitude to God for the Thessalonian believers.
- Genuine saving faith is demonstrated practically through tangible good works and righteous action.
- Christian love is marked by sacrificial, demanding labor done on behalf of others.
- Biblical hope is a confident certainty in God's promises that enables steadfast endurance in trials.
- Giving thanks reminds believers that every praiseworthy spiritual fruit is a gift from God.

### 3 Keys to Serving God
Author: Jessica Van Roekel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/3-keys-to-serving-god-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 1:2-4
Points:
- Ministry and serving others often bring friction, weariness, and relational challenges.
- Faith acts as the starting mechanism that responds to God's calling and sets service into motion.
- Love for God serves as the internal engine that drives believers forward through difficulties.
- Steadfast hope anchored in Jesus provides the endurance needed to keep serving without giving up.
